variant.title: Diagonal Sudoku
variant.description: Digits cannot repeat on either main diagonal.
rule.diagonal_repeat: Digits cannot repeat on the same diagonal.
rule.single_diagonal_repeat: Digits cannot repeat on the same diagonal.
rule_guide.title: Diagonal Sudoku Rules
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3×3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: Digits may not repeat on either of the two main diagonals.
